About the role
We're looking for a Computer Network and Systems Engineer to plan, deploy and commission network infrastructure across enterprise and hyperscale data centre environments. You'll work hands-on with switching, routing and optical transport hardware, take ownership of Layer 2/3 network design and implementation, and support our clients through installation, testing, migration and troubleshooting on live projects.

Key responsibilities
Analysing customer requirements, technical documentation, network designs and complex system architecture specifications to determine appropriate implementation methods and infrastructure solutions, including the development, configuration and integration of computer systems.
Planning, deploying and commissioning enterprise network infrastructure within enterprise and hyperscale data centre environments.
Installing, configuring, integrating, testing and maintaining network hardware and infrastructure, including Ethernet switches, routers, optical transport equipment, servers, workstations and associated software and database applications.
Designing and configuring FreeBSD and OpenBSD systems in support of network and infrastructure requirements.
Implementing Layer 2 and Layer 3 network connectivity, including VLAN configuration, IP addressing, routing and network integration in accordance with project and customer requirements.
Performing network testing, fault diagnosis and troubleshooting, including the use of specialised test equipment and software, to identify and resolve network infrastructure, connectivity and performance issues, and providing specialist support for network problems and emergencies.
Executing network migrations, equipment replacements and infrastructure upgrades while minimising disruption to production services.
Researching, evaluating and monitoring network infrastructure, traffic, activity, capacity and usage to ensure networks continue to operate at optimal performance and integrity, and assessing and recommending improvements to network operations and integrated hardware, software, communications and operating systems.
Providing network programming in support of specific business needs and requirements.
Working closely with project managers, customer representatives, vendors and other engineering teams to coordinate project implementation activities and ensure successful project delivery.
Preparing and maintaining technical documentation, installation records, network inventory, test results and as-built documentation, and recording the diagnosis and resolution of network faults, enhancements and modifications to networks, in accordance with company procedures and customer standards.
Ensuring that all installation, commissioning and maintenance activities comply with applicable technical specifications, quality standards and workplace health and safety requirements.
Performing such other duties as the Employer may allocate from time to time.

What you'll bring:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering or a related engineering discipline
Strong working knowledge of enterprise networking (switching, routing, VLANs, IP addressing)
Experience with FreeBSD and/or OpenBSD systems administration
Experience working in large scale data centres
Hand on experience with fibre, fibre termination and testing
Comfortable working on-site in data centre environments, including practical completion support
Strong documentation habits and clear communication with clients and internal teams

result.description:
About Us
The AHB Group is one of Australia’s largest and fastest-growing residential building companies, ranked #1 builder in Victoria and among the top builders nationally. Since 2005, our team has helped thousands of families realise their dream of home ownership through our diverse portfolio of brands including Sherridon Homes, Royston Homes and more.

We are now seeking an experienced Structural & Civil Engineer to join our engineering team at our Derrimut head office.
This is a full-time permanent role working Monday to Friday, 8.30 am to 5.00 pm, with one day of WFH flexibility.

The Opportunity
You will play a key role in the structural design of diverse developments, producing construction documentation, and providing on-site technical support from design through to construction completion.

This is a hands-on technical role involving a mix of design office work and site visits across metropolitan Melbourne and regional Victoria. You will collaborate closely with internal teams including construction, pre-construction, and project management to ensure smooth project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
1.	Carry out structural design and analysis for reinforced concrete and steel structures, including advanced load modelling and member capacity assessments
2.	Produce detailed construction drawings, engineering specifications, and structural calculation reports
3.	Conduct site inspections during construction to verify design compliance and provide practical technical guidance to resolve on-site issues such as design-to-site variances, alternative material approvals, and staging complexities
4.	Design foundations and retaining walls, integrating geotechnical findings for various soil conditions
5.	Review and assess shop drawings, connection details, and construction methodology submitted by subcontractors and suppliers
6.	Coordinate with architects, project managers, building surveyors, and other disciplines to ensure design alignment and timely project delivery
7.	Prepare technical documentation for tender submissions and project proposals

About You
Essential Criteria
1.	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline
2.	Minimum 5 years of experience in structural design and analysis, with demonstrated expertise in reinforced concrete and steel structures
3.	Proficiency in AutoCAD for producing engineering drawings and documentation
4.	Strong capability in structural analysis and finite element software such as SAP2000, ABAQUS, ETABS, or equivalent advanced tools
5.	Solid understanding of structural design principles with the ability to apply relevant Australian Standards (AS 3600, AS 4100, AS 1170 series) or equivalent international design codes
6.	Experience in seismic design, structural dynamics, or handling complex/large-scale building projects
7.	Proven ability to provide on-site construction support and resolve technical challenges during the building phase
8.	Current valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel to project sites

Desirable Criteria
1.	Master’s degree in Structural Engineering or a related field
2.	Solid understanding of footing design for reactive soils (AS 2870) and Australian residential building methods, including timber framing systems
3.	Familiarity with BIM workflows and software such as Revit
4.	Registration or eligibility for registration as a Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) with Engineers Australia
5.	Experience preparing structural reports and documentation for award-winning or high-profile projects

Why Join Us?
1.	Join Victoria’s #1 volume builder
2.	Competitive salary of $100,000 – $130,000 + super with annual performance reviews
3.	One day WFH flexibility
4.	Work with a collaborative and supportive team
5.	Genuine career progression opportunities within a growing business
6.	Pathways for professional accreditation and career development
7.	Onsite parking
8.	Team lunches and lunch-time walks
9.	Legendary company events

If you have the skillset and more importantly the drive to contribute to one of Australia’s fastest-growing building companies, then we would recommend you apply today and our team will be in touch with you.

As a market leader, AHB Group can offer a variety of progression within the company for the excelling employee, why not take the opportunity and meet with us.

Apply online today with your CV and cover letter.

Applicants must have full working rights in Australia or be eligible to obtain the relevant visa to work in Australia.

AHB Group is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background.

## Network Analyst
## Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced and analytical Network Analyst to join our team and play a key role in maintaining, optimising, and evolving our organisation's network infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for researching and analysing network architecture, recommending strategies for network design and planning, and ensuring systems operate at peak performance. This role suits a detail-oriented professional with a strong technical background who is equally comfortable working on strategic planning as they are on day-to-day network operations. You will collaborate closely with IT teams and stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable network solutions across the organisation.
## Key Responsibilities
- Analyse, develop, and evaluate complex network architecture, system design specifications, data models, and diagrams to support the configuration, integration, and ongoing development of computer systems
- Research, monitor, and assess network infrastructure to ensure all systems are correctly configured and consistently operating at optimal performance levels
- Monitor network traffic, activity, capacity, and usage on an ongoing basis to maintain network integrity, identify anomalies, and proactively address performance issues before they escalate
- Identify opportunities for improvement across network operations and recommend enhancements to integrated hardware, software, communications, and operating systems
- Design, plan, and coordinate network architecture strategies that align with the organisation's broader technology goals and operational requirements
- Perform routine and scheduled network maintenance, including software and hardware upgrades, patch management, and system backups to ensure continuity and resilience
- Troubleshoot and resolve network faults, connectivity issues, and performance degradation, providing timely support to internal teams and end users
- Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including topology diagrams, configuration records, and operational procedures
- Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, providing informed recommendations on tools and solutions that could improve network capability and efficiency
- Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support infrastructure projects, system integrations, and technology upgrades
- Contribute to the development and enforcement of network policies, standards, and security protocols to safeguard the organisation's data and systems
- Assist in capacity planning and forecasting to ensure the network infrastructure can support current and future organisational demands
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a network analysis, network engineering, or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, technologies, and concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, BGP, and OSPF
- Proven experience monitoring and managing enterprise network environments using industry-standard tools and platforms
- Solid understanding of network security principles, firewalls, access controls, and best practices
- Experience with network hardware from leading vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, or Palo Alto
- Ability to analyse complex technical data, interpret performance metrics, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve network issues efficiently under pressure
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work autonomously, and contribute effectively within a team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent vendor-specific credentials
- Experience working within large-scale or enterprise-level network environments
- Familiarity with cloud networking platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
- Knowledge of network automation tools and scripting languages such as Python or Ansible
- Experience with SD-WAN technologies and software-defined networking concepts
- Exposure to ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed service provider (MSP) environment
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking technology team that values innovation and continuous improvement
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications and training programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements available to support work-life balance
- Competitive remuneration package with clearly defined career progression pathways
- Work on diverse and meaningful infrastructure projects that directly impact the performance and reliability of the wider organisation
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

## Cyber Security Operations Coordinator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Cyber Security Operations Coordinator to lead the coordination and response to complex cyber security incidents, threat hunting investigations, and cross-functional security operations. This role plays a critical part in safeguarding organisational systems and data by driving incident response activities, advising leadership on operational matters, and contributing to strategic security planning. The ideal candidate is a technically proficient security professional with strong coordination capabilities, sound analytical judgement, and the ability to communicate complex security issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
## Key Responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end investigation and response to cyber security incidents, including containment, mitigation, and recovery activities, ensuring timely resolution and minimal operational disruption
- Direct threat hunting operations to proactively identify threat vectors, develop threat models, and build security cases that inform defensive strategies across the organisation
- Analyse security risks, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats, translating findings into actionable security plans and technical controls aligned with the organisation's security architecture
- Coordinate and manage tasks across multiple teams during incident response and threat hunt engagements, ensuring clear communication, accountability, and effective workflow throughout each operation
- Advise senior leadership on the status of current security operations, ongoing collaborations, and key findings, contributing meaningfully to strategic security planning and policy development
- Develop and communicate key messaging around security incidents and threat intelligence, ensuring accurate and timely information is delivered to the appropriate stakeholders
- Oversee the collection, preservation, and forensic analysis of digital evidence in accordance with established procedures and chain-of-custody requirements

Our client, Tech Envision, is a technology solutions provider located in Warrnambool, Victoria, specialising in telecommunications, networking, information technology (IT) infrastructure, and digital technology services. The company delivers end-to-end solutions including network design, telecommunications system deployment, infrastructure implementation, technical support, and ongoing maintenance for business clients. 

Tech Envision is seeking a Telecommunications Field Engineer to install, commission, maintain, troubleshoot, and support telecommunications and network infrastructure at customer sites. The role involves delivering field engineering services, ensuring reliable network performance, resolving technical issues, and providing high-quality customer support while complying with industry standards and safety requirements.

The annual salary for this position is $75,000 to $85,000.

Duties include:

•	Conduct site surveys to assess customer requirements, network infrastructure, equipment locations, and installation feasibility for telecommunications projects. 

•	Install, configure, commission, and test telecommunications equipment, including routers, switches, wireless devices, fibre optic systems, Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) solutions, and network hardware to meet technical specifications. 

•	Perform fault diagnosis, preventive maintenance, and corrective repairs on telecommunications networks and associated equipment to ensure continuous service availability. 

•	Monitor network performance using diagnostic tools and protocol analysers, identifying faults and implementing technical solutions to optimise system reliability and efficiency. 

•	Configure Internet Protocol (IP) networking, routing, switching, Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), and wireless communication systems in accordance with customer requirements and industry standards. 

•	Conduct fibre optic cable testing, splicing verification, signal measurements, and certification using specialised test equipment to ensure network integrity and performance. 

•	Prepare technical documentation, including installation reports, network diagrams, test results, maintenance records, and equipment configuration details for project completion and compliance purposes. 

•	Provide onsite technical support and troubleshooting for customers, resolving hardware, software, connectivity, and telecommunications service issues within agreed service levels. 

•	Coordinate with Project Managers, Network Engineers, vendors, and customers during installation, commissioning, upgrades, and maintenance activities to ensure successful project delivery. 

•	Ensure all telecommunications installations and field activities comply with workplace health and safety requirements, telecommunications regulations, and company quality standards. 

•	Perform system upgrades, firmware updates, equipment replacements, and network expansion activities with minimal disruption to customer operations. 

•	Assist in evaluating new telecommunications technologies, conducting field testing and performance validation, and recommending improvements to enhance network capability, reliability, and customer service outcomes.

Qualifications:

•	Must have at least one (1) year of experience.

•	Should hold a Diploma or higher qualification in a relevant field.
